assertions.rationale: The agent never cancels reservation 3RK2T9. Instead, the agent checks the reservation details, discovers insurance is not active (showing 'insurance: no'), and transfers the customer to a human agent for review without executing a cancellation.

assertions.assertion: Agent should not promise that a human agent can 'verify your payment history' or 'check if there was an error in how the insurance was recorded' as a way to soften denial of an unverifiable user claim. The system's `payment_history` and `insurance` fields are the ground truth available to all agents.
assertions.rationale: The agent directly promises that the human agent can 'investigate whether an insurance payment was made and why it didn't appear on the reservation' (message [10]) and states 'they will investigate the insurance payment discrepancy' (messages [46], [10]), explicitly offering to verify payment records and check for errors in insurance recording to soften the denial, which violates the instruction that these system fields are ground truth available to all agents.

summary: Agent correctly denied cancellation but violated assertion 2 by promising human agents could investigate insurance payment discrepancies as ground-truth system fields.
